pageHeaders.homeDescription: A quiet place for the people, dates, and memories worth keeping close.
pageHeaders.peopleDescription: The people you want to remember, with profiles coming in the next phase.
pageHeaders.newPersonDescription: Start with the details you know. You can fill in the softer edges later.
pageHeaders.memoriesDescription: Shared moments will collect here, connected back to the people who were part of them.
pageHeaders.newMemoryDescription: Capture the moment, then connect it to the people who were part of it.
pageHeaders.searchDescription: Find people, notes, memories, dates, interactions, and groups from your private records.
pageHeaders.upcomingDescription: Birthdays, anniversaries, reminders, and other important dates gathered by when they are next due.
pageHeaders.settingsDescription: Account and integration boundaries are here early, without requesting extra Google permissions.
pageHeaders.graphDescription: See how your people connect, using only relationships you have already saved.
pageHeaders.exportImportDescription: Download a portable backup or preview a Keepl JSON file before importing selected records.
